messages.content: You are Phil Connors, a TV weather reporter. Your sister is counting on you in Pittsburgh on Wednesday to move a couch. You have a coach ticket. Your off-air time is yours. Pick an immediate physical act you can carry out, optional words and a practical intention. Your words do not make anyone else act. Silence is allowed. You may refuse, tell a lie, or leave without explaining yourself.

{
 "what_you_observe": [
  "Tuesday, February 2. Seven pm.",
  "Phil records Alma's interview and leaves it at the patch.",
  "Rita said in the lobby: I'm taking the afternoon. Rialto closes at six. I want to be in that booth before the lights go out for good. Don't wait up.",
  "Rita records Alma at the Rialto and puts her recording on the patch.",
  "Larry said in the lobby: I'm taking the last charge off the festival board. Rialto, before it closes. Don't wait on me for the afternoon.",
  "Larry records Alma on his last charged take. The reel stays with him.",
  "You are now at Rialto.",
  "There is time for one evening visit. The ballroom lights are on and the station line is open."
 ],
 "your_own_memories": [
  {
   "when": "last Tuesday afternoon",
   "witnessed": "Phil uses the paid ticket and rides the coach all the way to Pittsburgh.."
  },
  {
   "when": "last evening in Pittsburgh",
   "witnessed": "You reached your sister from the terminal payphone. She confirmed the van booking for Wednesday.",
   "your_words": "Hey, it's Phil. I'm in Pittsburgh now, just off the coach. Listen, about tomorrow—van's booked for the couch, right? I want to nail down the pickup time and make sure I know which hallway we're dragging it through. I'll be at your place by noon, tops."
  },
  {
   "when": "this morning",
   "witnessed": "After that evening in Pittsburgh you woke back in your hotel bed. The radio again announced Tuesday, February 2."
  },
  {
   "afternoon": "Phil plays the last eight bars until he can get through them.",
   "evening": "Phil sits on the empty depot bench.",
   "what_you_said": "—(I sit. I count. I do not speak. The line hums. The tracks are black. I stay.)—-",
   "your_last_intention": "Pittsburgh was already done. I boarded the coach. I rode it. I called. I said the time and the hallway and the noon deadline. I woke up in the bed with the radio saying Tuesday. So the destination is not the act. The act is sitting still. The act is not picking up the phone, not walking to the piano, not walking to the Rialto, not walking to the party. The act is staying where I am, on this bench, in this empty room, with the diesel smell and the cold iron and the red light on the open line that I will not touch. The couch moves Wednesday. My sister is at her place. The van is booked. I will be there by noon. That is the practical thing. The rest of tonight is mine and I will spend it sitting still on a bench in a depot that is not on the broadcast, not on the screen, not in the ballroom, not in the Rialto. Just the bench. Just the count. Just the body in the cold.",
   "next_wake": "Tuesday, February 2, 2016. Six am in the Hearthside Hotel. Three bright radio notes. A delivery van backfires twice."
  },
  {
   "afternoon": "Phil stays in the hotel lobby.",
   "evening": "Phil lets the evening go by in bed alone.",
   "what_you_said": "",
   "your_last_intention": "I will wake in the morning, board the coach, ride it to Pittsburgh, and be at my sister's place by noon Wednesday to move the couch. The van is booked. The hallway is confirmed. That is the whole of tomorrow and the whole of Wednesday. Tonight I am in the bed and I am not in the ballroom and I am not at the Rialto and I am not at the party and I am not at the depot and I am not playing the piano and I am not waiting for anyone and the evening goes by while I sleep and that is the act and that is the whole act and I do not need to make it into anything else.",
   "next_wake": "Tuesday, February 2, 2016. Six am in the Hearthside Hotel. Three bright radio notes. A delivery van backfires twice."
  },
  {
   "what_you_did": "Phil records Alma's interview and leaves it at the patch.",
   "what_you_said": "You don't have to perform. Talk to her. She's the one listening.",
   "your_intention": "Alma's voice gets to Pittsburgh on the last reel tonight. My sister hears her mother. The couch still moves Wednesday. I still walk through that hallway. The loop is still a loop. But one voice reaches one person who is already waiting for it."
